newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Oil's second hydrocracker seen up by end-Feb.
newsitem.headline: Thai Oil's second hydrocracker seen up by end-Feb.

text.p: Thai Oil Co Ltd said on Wednesday that its second hydrocracker unit, which will increase its diesel output to 55 percent of the production, is expected to start up by the end of February.
Company chairman and managing director Kasame Chatikavanij said the unit, with a 27,000 barrels per day (bpd) capacity, will rise to full capacity by March or April.
The company hoped to sell most its refined products in the Thai market, leaving a maximum five percent of output, or 50 million liters per month, available for export.
"We don't want to export at all because there are no incentives. It's the situation that forces us to," he said, referring to surpluses after two new Thai refineries came onstream last year.
Thai Oil said it exported 400-500 million liters near the end of the 1995/96 fiscal year.
